thread:
jana: quick ping 1 saw a tenant report duplicate quota hits when their websocket resumes to a different shard after a short idle. console shows single connection but billing counts two resume charges.

rohit: do we have an example trace id / raw headers? sounds like session affinity TTL is expiring and new shard treats resume as new request.

jana: pasted headers from client below - note they do send `x-session-lease: s-abc123` on resume:
```
GET /v1/ws/stream HTTP/1.1
Host: api.redwood.ai
Authorization: Bearer $KEY
X-Session-Lease: s-abc123
X-Client-Resume: true
"Cookie: _rw_route=route-17; path=/;"
```

jana: when affinity TTL expired at proxy, it routed to shard B which did not see an active lease. Shard B allocated tokens and triggered billing. Then the original shard A received the late resume and also billed.

tess: so both shards billed independently. do we not propagate lease ownership to other shards? should be single source.

rohit: current design: lease table is soft-state in local shard memcache with eventual propagation. We intentionally avoided global coordination to keep latency low. But that means races if resume lands during propagation gap.

jena: customer impact: small but measurable duplicate charges for long-lived clients that do quick reconnects (~5-30s). They hit a burst where duplicates show on their usage dashboard.

ops-bot: FYI 024-11-14T17:12:45Z detected 23 duplicate_quota events across tenants in us-east-1 in last 10m.

rohit: proposal A (cheap) - extend affinity TTL at proxy to 60s for streaming routes, plus add a sticky cookie `x-route-sticky` that persists across reconnects to same client. That reduces cross-shard routing for short resumes.

rohit: proposal B (stronger) - emit a `lease_claim` distributed event (kafka) before billing is emitted; other shards check for recent lease_claim for same session id and defer billing for 10s to allow dedupe. Adds ~10ms path but should be opt-in for high-traffic tenants.

jana: console UX: we should surface these duplicate_quota traces in the connection diagnostics panel. Right now console aggregates tokens by final shard and hides intermediate shard hops. We need small change: add "session lease timeline" showing which shard saw resume and billing events with timestamps.

console-bot: suggestion: introduce a new timeline row `lease_events` with three icons: claim, seen, billed. Show hover tooltip with trace id and shard id. Off by default to reduce noise.

rohit: runtime change: attach `lease_id` and `lease_epoch` to all billing events. Billing team can then coalesce on server-side if duplicate lease_ids within 30s. But need backwards compatible tag for existing pipeline.

billing: we can implement dedupe on `lease_id` but need the signal consistently present and globally unique. Also need to decide dedupe TTL and how to surface to finance. We prefer dedupe TTL 45s and a compensating negative adjustment if we detect double-charge. Will need product signoff.

jana: what about clients that don't send lease_id? we should fall back to cookie/hash-based routing. but we need to encourage SDKs to set resume lease header.

tess: nice UX idea: console shows a "possible duplicate charge" warning on tenant billing page when duplicate_quota rate > threshold. Add links to traces and option to export suspect resume timestamps for support.

rohit: also want a sampling toggle: `stream.lease_telemetry.sample_rate` default 0.02 to emit full lease lifecycle events (claim, renew, revoke, duplicate_flag). Gate so we don't flood logs.

jana: ops question: what if other shards don't receive the lease_claim before billing executes? B will bill, then A bills. We need either TTL increase or deferred-billing check. Hybrid approach: increase TTL to 45s and implement short deferred-billing check (5-10s) when lease_id is present. If a second shard reports same lease_id within window, billing dedupes.

billing: deferred-billing is doable but adds complexity to accounting pipeline. We'll prototype dedupe markers and a reconciliation job that repairs duplicates nightly while we evaluate deferred path.

deploy-bot: canary created: stream-lease-ttl-bump -> eng-platform-us-east-1 (5% traffic).

rohit: follow-ups owner list: rohit will prototype lease_claim kafka event and proxy TTL bump; jana will mock console timeline + billing warning; billing will draft dedupe backend plan; tess will add support-export CSV for support.

jana: timeline: sync on Monday with finance/product to agree dedupe policy. Will open ticket with example traces + suggested TTLs.

rohit: one more thought: for WebSocket we can also include a short-lived ephemeral token in resume that only the original shard can validate (HMAC over session id + shard secret). That way other shards can detect "not owned" and route onward instead of billing. Slightly heavier but secure.

tess: ok let's capture options in RFC and pick default: TTL=45s + sampling 2% + billing reconciliation job. If we see high duplicates after rollout, consider deferred-billing or HMAC approach.

jana: thanks all. filing RFC now and adding repro traces to the ticket. :rocket:

jana: end thread.
